## About This Project

This project explores the connections between oral health and systemic pathology using a clinical research cohort of 350 patients (hundreds of individuals, not thousands). 

### Data Overview

- **Cohort Size:** 350 patients (in the hundreds)
- **Oral Health Markers:** Periodontal stage, probing pocket depth (PPD), bleeding on probing (BOP), clinical attachment loss (CAL), missing teeth, salivary MMP-8, and *P. gingivalis* load
- **Systemic Markers:** HbA1c, hs-CRP, systolic/diastolic blood pressure, and eGFR
